payload.claim: The `covers` field's docstring says 'The sets this claim's witness is meant to drive', naming only the witness. But `coverage_problems` (and `CoveredMember`'s own docstring two paragraphs above, 'driven_by names a test or a prose source') treat a member as driven by either the criterion's witness or any of its `wrong_versions`. The field comment narrows the mechanism to the witness alone, which is the one vocabulary term CONTEXT.md defines precisely as a single named test, so it misdescribes what the adjacent code in the same file actually checks.
